title: Two Sum Sorted
statement: Implement `solve(nums, target)`. `nums` is sorted ascending and contains distinct integers. Return `[i, j]` with `i < j` and `nums[i] + nums[j] == target`. If no pair exists, return `[-1, -1]`. Move the left index right when the sum is too small and the right index left when the sum is too large.
hints: Start indexes at the two ends.
A low sum moves the left index because the right value is already the largest available partner.

approaches.name: Two pointers
approaches.explanation: On a sorted array the ends are the smallest and largest remaining values.

editorial: On a sorted array the ends are the smallest and largest remaining values. If the sum is low, only a larger left value can help. If it is high, only a smaller right value can help. Each step discards an index, so the scan is linear and does not need a hash map.
